request.caption:
A cinematic indie folk-pop song. narrative vocal song with clear emotional arc.
Vocal character: clear warm English vocal, sincere storytelling delivery.
Core instrumentation palette: piano, strings, light percussion.
Narrative arc name: cinematic_transformational.
Cinematic / Transformational narrative trajectory.
Musical narrative progression with approximate timing:
- 0–8s [opening]: vulnerability; mood uncertain; low energy, spacious; instrumentation piano, ambient_pad; vocal delivery intimate.
- 8–18s [challenge]: struggle; mood tense; moderate energy; instrumentation piano, strings, low_percussion; vocal delivery restrained.
- 18–28s [determination]: courage; mood determined; rising energy, denser arrangement; instrumentation piano, strings, drums; vocal delivery rising.
- 28–40s [breakthrough]: breakthrough; mood triumphant; high energy, climactic intensity; instrumentation full_band, strings, drums; vocal delivery powerful.
- 40–48s [resolution]: forward_motion; mood peaceful; moderate energy; instrumentation piano, strings; vocal delivery warm.
Follow the narrative section labels present in the lyrics; each tagged section should match the timed musical intent above.
request.lyrics:
[Opening - uncertain - low energy, spacious]
You don't have to have everything figured out today.
You just have to take the next step.

[Challenge - tense - moderate energy]
Every challenge you've faced has taught you something,
and every setback has given you another chance to grow.
There will be moments when you doubt yourself.

[Determination - determined - rising energy, denser arrangement]
There will be moments when the path ahead feels uncertain.
But courage isn't the absence of doubt.
It's choosing to move forward anyway.

[Breakthrough - triumphant - high energy, climactic intensity]
One step becomes another.
And eventually you look back and realize
that the person who was afraid to begin
became the person who kept going.

[Resolution - peaceful - moderate energy]
You are not finished.
You're still becoming.
Take the next step.
